newsitem.title: USA: Olin nearing decision on spin-off -- Paper.
newsitem.headline: Olin nearing decision on spin-off -- Paper.

text.p: Olin Corp may be nearing a decision on the possible spin-off of its military and aerospace operations, an article in the New York Times said.

A decision on this issue is expected to come up at the next board meeting on September 26 according to Richard Koch, Olin's vice president of investor relations. If no decision is made then, he said, the issue will surely be resolved at the next scheduled board meeting on October 31, the Times reported.
The chemical, brass and ammunition maker's stock has been rising since November 1995, when Olin announced it was considering divestiture, the Times noted.
The Times reported such a spinoff would free the company of a division that faces tough growth prospects.
Olin closed off 3/8 at 84-1/8 on Friday on the New York Stock Exchange.
